_comment: This file holds what JJ Flexible says and shows, for logging and cluster. EDITING: change the text on the right of the colon; never change the key on the left, and never change anything inside curly braces such as {radio} - those are filled in at run time with the actual radio name, frequency and so on. If an argument goes missing the placeholder is left standing rather than blanked, so you would hear the word radio in braces spoken aloud - that is a bug worth reporting, not something you caused. A key with no text is spoken as the key itself, so if you hear something like connect.radio_found read out literally, that key needs text. LADDERS: a few keys hold several tiers instead of one string - critical, terse, chatty and sometimes diagnostic - which is how one message gets shorter as you turn verbosity down. Edit the tier you want; leave the others alone. YOUR OWN COPY: put a file of this same name in the lexicon folder beside your settings and it layers on top of this one, key by key - you only need the keys you want to change, and everything else keeps working. If your file has a typo in it, it is ignored and this one is used, so a mistake can never stop the program. SOME WORDS ARE ALSO INSTRUCTIONS: a handful of these strings are matched by the program to decide what to do next, so editing them can change behaviour rather than only wording. Those are being untangled; until they are, if something stops working after an edit, that is why. See docs/planning/active/string-store-contract.md.
